scope: Theorem 7.12 of the manuscript “Distortion of countably branching diamonds from midpoint and tree energies” (preprints/Diamond-distortion-from-midpoint-and-tree-energies-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d71f7eafe03d0d83), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If a Banach space admits an equivalent asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm, then the family (Dk)k≥0 does not embed into it with uniformly bounded distortion. Write cof(X) for the closed finite-codimensional linear subspaces of X. In infinite dimension, midpoint convexity may be expressed by positivity of the maximum modulus δmax N (t) = inf N(u)=1 sup F∈cof(X) inf y∈F N(y)=1 max ± N(u ± ty) − 1  > 0 (0 < t < 1). (7.10)
